title: Playing with Picou and Peter Bocage; Sidney Desvigne's Maple Leaf band
summary: Rene recalls working with Dr. Bechet's group and Picou, trumpeter Peter Bocage's bands, and Sidney Desvigne who once had the Maple Leaf band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well I wanted to ask you about Piku too before I forget it. You say you worked with Piku at one time? You told me before?

Yeah. Yeah. I played several occasions. I played with, like I said, with Dr. B. Sheik. Mm-hmm. And with another occasion I played. Oh! You know who that trumpet plays? Peter LeCobb. And who did he play with? With the, uh, uh, Duncan Oedis. Young Superior. Oh yeah. You know him? Oh yeah, I do. Yeah, that's the one. That's the one. It came to my mind. Peter LeCobb. Mm-hmm. Yeah.

That was the one. And, uh, let's see what we were talking about before. Now, that's good. Big I, Lloyd Piku? Yeah. Well you say you did work with Piku and Peter Locage and Dr. Neltz, uh, Dr. Bache on the record. But Peter Locage played with Dr. Ernest. Oh yeah, he played with Dr. Ernest too. But I knew this band there they were setting up, you know?

Mm-hmm. It was me, Dr. Bache, uh, O'Neal, on the violin. And I'm sure it's Piku and the players. I'm not sure. But I can't think of the trumpet players. He played straight, see? They couldn't play no jazz at all. He played straight. All now. All straight. But they could cut that music, you know? That wasn't Peter Locage, huh? No, no, no. Peter Locage was playing with the young, young, uh, Telsiti, you see?
Talk to me now. What about Sidney Dersween? Who did he play with? You mentioned him before the machine was on.
Sidney Dersween once had the Maple Leaf band. Oh, yeah. Then after he had his own band, he always had the band behind his, maybe he had his own band. He had the band.
